value.rationale: The fixed-n exact oscillation norm is a natural positive-approximation stability invariant and the sharp uniform one-step TV contraction for an arbitrary-prior Beta-Binomial Gibbs kernel. Reducing infinitely many pairs of rows to a computable endpoint integral under arbitrary positive interior-mass measures—including discrete and singular ones—is a structural theorem, not just a numerical sample. The uniform-prior exact law 1-2^{-n} exposes a sharp worst-case one-step regime distinct from spectral decay; multistep sharpness is not overstated.
